title: tech-note-9: companion runs and code for "Decomposition Buys Budget at Best, Nothing Usually"
description: Pre-registration (with its two recorded protocol revisions), runner, item selection, the 560 decomposition runs (plan, subtask results, assembled answer, correctness, per-call token counts and cost; GPQA Diamond records carry no text and per-item random tokens in place of answers, per the dataset's terms), the statistics script and the results of the technical note "Decomposition Buys Budget at Best, Nothing Usually" (https://alatip.github.io/decomposition-buys-budget/, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23273230).
